question: Cerebral palsy is the most common cause of childhood physical disability.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is true. Cerebral palsy is the most common cause of childhood physical disability worldwide, affecting approximately 2–3 per 1,000 live births. In India, birth asphyxia (hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy) accounts for a disproportionately large fraction of cases compared to high-income countries, making improved obstetric and neonatal care a priority for prevention.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Cerebral palsy is the most prevalent cause of physical disability in children, with an estimated global prevalence of 2–3 per 1,000 live births. In India, the majority of cases are attributable to preventable causes — predominantly birth asphyxia (hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy) — highlighting the critical role of skilled birth attendance and neonatal resuscitation.
